title: Lost Armada
html_source: Perhaps referring to the Spanish armada that was supposed to invade England in 1588. A great deal of the ships either ran aground or sank due to violent storms, hence the “wood sieved by the shipworm”. The armada managed to regrouped north of England after the initial interruptions, and attempted to sail around Ireland to return to Spain, but the storms persisted, and more were lost. They accomplished nothing.
